name: Neuronic Flasher

dispatch_notes.coder-mobile: BLE communication, platform permissions, firmware transfer protocol
dispatch_notes.coder-frontend: Flutter UI screens, GetX controllers, navigation flow
dispatch_notes.coder: General Dart logic, services, models, environment config
dispatch_notes.debugger: BLE connectivity issues, firmware transfer failures
dispatch_notes.ci-cd: GitHub Actions: Android APK → Firebase, iOS → TestFlight

guidance.stack_summary: Dart 3.x / Flutter 3.38.5 / GetX / AWS Cognito Amplify / flutter_reactive_ble / GetStorage
structure: lib/config/ — Amplify config, BLE UUIDs, environment loading
lib/models/ — Firmware version and scanned device models
lib/services/ — Auth, BLE, firmware, storage services
lib/controllers/ — Auth, scan, firmware selection, flash progress controllers
lib/screens/ — Login, scan, firmware selection, flash progress screens
conventions: Service initialization order: StorageService → AuthService → BleService → FirmwareService
JSON commands over BLE (MTU 512, 509 effective payload)
ci_cd: PR merge to main → auto version bump → Android APK (Firebase App Distribution) + iOS IPA (TestFlight)
Env file generated from GitHub secrets at build time
Flutter 3.38.5 pinned, JDK 17 for Android, Xcode 16.4 for iOS

custom_rules: BLE firmware flashing tool — primary purpose is writing firmware to Neuronic devices
API endpoints: POST /list-firmware-versions, POST /firmware-download-version (Bearer token auth)
iOS: Privacy - Bluetooth Peripheral Usage Description required
